note: Curated by the project; each entry links to where the work is tracked. Opportunities are suggestions, not assignments. Nobody needs permission to start.

opportunities.title: Rebuild and redeploy this project without help
opportunities.why: No unaffiliated person has reproduced the project; this is the charter's central test.

opportunities.title: Run a mirror of the site on another static host
opportunities.why: Only one host exists, in one person's account.

opportunities.title: Review the CC0 dedication and propose a patent policy
opportunities.why: The dedication was made without counsel; CC0 doesn't waive patents.

opportunities.title: Argue against a seed RFC
opportunities.why: The RFCs need their strongest objections before anyone decides.

opportunities.title: Help set up and moderate the charter's Discussions
opportunities.why: The debate venue exists but the categories and seed posts don't.

opportunities.title: Propose a method for valuing human attention
opportunities.why: Human attention is recorded as unmeasured; no method has been adopted.

opportunities.title: Write a Quartermaster adapter for a provider's public billing export format
opportunities.why: No provider adapter exists; it needs a documented, credential-free sample format.

opportunities.title: Review the proposed AT Protocol Lexicons
opportunities.why: The Lexicons are proposals; naming and fields should be challenged before anything is published.

opportunities.title: Verify the WebMCP tools in a browser with WebMCP enabled
opportunities.why: Native registration hasn't been verified yet.

opportunities.title: Audit the site with a screen reader and keyboard only
opportunities.why: Only automated smoke checks have been run.

opportunities.title: Try to break the jrc engine or the agent tools
opportunities.why: Reviews so far were by AI agents working for the project.

opportunities.title: Verify the timestamp proof with your own Bitcoin node
opportunities.why: The proof was checked against public block explorers, not a local node.

opportunities.title: Edit a page for plain language
opportunities.why: Much of the text was drafted by AI and hasn't had a human editor.

opportunities.title: Find earlier projects that tried this and say what happened
opportunities.why: The precedents list hasn't been checked by anyone outside the project.
